subject: Bridge-topup request for Gamma Analytics latency soak
messages:
From: Alan Rowe <alan.rowe@gamma-analytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@gamma-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term top-up for latency soak

Hi Grace,

Quick one from our side — we have a latency-focused POC window scheduled for the evening of Jun 11 (team plans to run a 48-hour soak to validate tail latency under sustained concurrency). After an initial smoke yesterday we need additional credits to complete the full run: roughly 250k token allowance (ephemeral) for a 48-hour window.

Attached is the test plan and traffic matrix. The run is time-sensitive for regulatory reasons on our end (demo to execs on Jun 15). Can Redwood provision a temporary top-up that kicks off Jun 11 18:00 UTC and expires automatically after 48 hours? If you need a short form or PO, procurement is on copy (procurement@gamma-analytics.com).

If possible, please confirm by EOD today so we can finalize the schedule.

Thanks — appreciate the fast help.

Regards,
Alan Rowe
Senior Performance Engineer
Gamma Analytics
[Attachment: gamma_latency_test_plan.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Rowe <alan.rowe@gamma-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, procurement@gamma-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term top-up for latency soak

Alan — thanks for the note and the plan. Looping in Karthik (SE) and Ben (Account Ops) to scope and provision. A couple quick clarifying Qs for ops:

- Confirmed start: Jun 11 18:00 UTC?
- Exact token target: you said ~250k — is that peak expected tokens or total allotment?
- Do you require a formal PO/DocuSign before we release the allowance, or can we provision a one-time ephemeral grant for trial customers and follow up with procurement paperwork?

Karthik/Ben — provisional ask from Gamma for a 48h ephemeral uplift for throughput/latency validation. They indicated this is a demo-critical run; if we can release a temporary allowance that auto-revokes after 48h that will limit risk. Attaching the test plan they provided for visibility.

Next steps: if ops can provision immediately (or set up a timed allocation), please confirm the exact token amount and window and whether this needs a billing exception.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: gamma_latency_test_plan.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alan Rowe <alan.rowe@gamma-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, procurement@gamma-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term top-up for latency soak

Thanks — reviewed the traffic matrix. We can support this with an ephemeral allocation. Recommended plan:

- Provision 250,000 tokens as a timed allowance
- Window: starts 2026-06-11 18:00 UTC, duration 48 hours (auto-expire: 2026-06-13 18:00 UTC)
- No billing charges during the window; tokens will be consumed against the ephemeral pool. If the account wants a longer run or recurring windows we will require a signed DocuSign addendum (linked below).

I created a provisional credit schedule that ops can apply; see attached CSV. If Ben can do the deployment, Gamma should be able to proceed at the scheduled start without interruption.

Alan — confirm acceptance of 250k / 48h and we’ll mark it for ops. Also confirming we’re not changing model variants — same model the team used in the smoke.

Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_schedule.csv]

All — I’ve provisioned the timed allowance in the tenant: 250,000 ephemeral tokens scheduled to start 2026-06-11 18:00 UTC and auto-expire 2026-06-13 18:00 UTC. No billing changes; this is a courtesy ephemeral grant for the POC run.

Gamma team: you should see the allowance in the console under "Allocations > Temporary". I attached a short allocation receipt for your records. If you want us to extend beyond the 48h window, please reply here and we’ll route through the DocuSign addendum.

Ben Carter
Account Operations — Redwood Inference
